subject: Breakdown & evidence handoff for security add-ons (audit logs, HSM, residency)
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security add-ons — cost split + evidence handoff

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We’re close to an internal procurement decision and have two final asks before we move to PO:

1) Can you provide a clear split between one-time implementation work vs recurring charges for the set of add-ons we discussed (audit logs longer retention, HSM seats/KMS, and data residency in us-east)? We need numbers that we can circulate to finance.

2) For compliance evidence: we need to know what artifacts Redwood will provide at onboarding vs ongoing (SOC2 report, audit-log retention SLA, export of HSM attestation evidence). Also whether those artifacts can be delivered to our secure S3 and if there’s any implementation fee for that handoff.

3) Finally, if we commit to a 12-month committed spend across hosted + these add-ons, is there a standard discount for the compliance bundle or a credit towards implementation?

We’re on a tight calendar for this quarter close — if you can send a short cost table and list of deliverables by EOD Tuesday that would help.

Thanks,
Elena
Procurement Lead, ClearPath Health

Attachments: ClearPath_SOC2_request.pdf (pdf)
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security add-ons — cost split + evidence handoff

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. Putting a shortball first pass below; happy to walk through on a 30-min call tomorrow.

Summary (ballpark, subject to SOW):
- One-time implementation & onboarding fee: $28,000 — covers HSM/KMS integration, audit-log routing to your S3, and evidence handoff (SOC2 artifacts + attestation packet).
- Audit-log retention (30 days default, 12-month retention tier): $1,250/month for 12-month tier (per account workload; includes storage + retention SLA).
- HSM seats (managed key safeguards + attestation streaming): $1,500/month per HSM seat.
- Data residency surcharge (us-east pinned): $0.06 per 1K tokens served above the hosted baseline (or we can map to a flat $3,000/month for predictable billing).

Evidence handoff and what you’ll receive:
- Onboarding: latest SOC2 type II report (pdf), HSM attestation summary (pdf), implementation checklist, and an export of initial audit-log snapshot. We will deliver onboarding artifacts to a secure S3 bucket you control — small set-up fee included in the one-time charge above.
- Ongoing: monthly access to rolling audit-log exports (on request), SLA metrics for retention, and on-demand attestation for HSM operations.

Discounting: we typically offer a concession on the onboarding fee for 12-month committed ARR across product + addons. Example: 30% off onboarding if you commit to a 12-month term for the bundle above (we can negotiate tiers for larger commits).

Next steps I suggest:
- I’ll put together a short mutual action plan and SOW to lock scope and timeline.
- If possible, confirm rough counts for HSM seats and expected monthly token volume so I can firm up the per-token residency proposal.

Happy to jump on a call — are you available 10/5 10:00–11:00am PT?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment references: ClearPath_SOC2_request.pdf (referenced), will include a draft SOW in the next email.
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Security add-ons — cost split + evidence handoff

Team — forwarding Elena’s procurement note and my quick ballpark. Need help on two things before I send the SOW draft:

1) Ben: can you run a quick cost model for us-east residency flat $3k/mo vs per-token at $0.06/1k? I want an internal cost delta and margin impact so we can price correctly.
2) Rachel: if we offer 30% off onboarding for 12-month commit, do we have precedent for structuring that as a prepaid credit applied to implementation invoice, or as a performance-based rebate? Procurement wants something on paper.

Original message quoted below.

-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Garcia <elena@clearpathhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 15:48:00 -07:00

Mina / Ben — quick update after talking to pricing & finance. I’ve attached a draft SOW (Comms_SOW_v1.docx) and a cleaned pricing table (pricing_table_v3.xlsx). Key changes and options to present to ClearPath: 

Option A (12-month committed bundle) — preferred for both sides:
- Onboarding fee: $19,600 (30% concession applied as prepaid credit).
- Audit-log 12-month tier: $1,100/month.
- HSM seat: $1,250/month per seat.
- Residency: we recommend flat $3,000/month for predictable billing.
- Implementation deliverables: SOC2 packet, HSM attestation, audit-log export to your S3, onboarding support (2 weeks).

Option B (no commit, à la carte):
- Onboarding fee: $28,000
- Audit-log 12-month tier: $1,250/month
- HSM seat: $1,500/month
- Residency per-token: $0.06 / 1k tokens

Notes on contracting mechanics:
- We typically apply the 12-month concession as a prepaid credit on the onboarding invoice (reduces PO amount up front). Finance is open to an alternative rebate, but procurement teams prefer credits applied at the start for cleaner AR.
- I added a clause in the SOW for evidence delivery: initial SOC2 + attestation delivered within 10 business days of signed SOW; monthly retention reporting provided as a CSV export on request.

If we want to be competitive on implementation time, I can offer a 10-day onboarding SLA for a small rush fee (included as an optional line).

Mina — if that looks good I’ll send the revised SOW to Elena and procurement with the Option A callout and put the hub deal in stage=propose.

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Sales Security Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Comms_SOW_v1.docx (docx), pricing_table_v3.xlsx (xlsx)
